_README: Titration thresholds transcribed from Dr. Barbour's review notes (themes T1/T4/T5/T8/T11 + the 2026-06 update). DRAFT - unverified: faithful to her written words but she must confirm exact numbers and that they apply across all drugs (NEEDS_PI_SIGNOFF.md). Duration uses the 2026-06 re-cut DURATION_RANK (under_1min=1, 1_3min=2, over_3min=3). Frequency RANGE buckets: daily/weekly/monthly/less_than_monthly (see FREQUENCY_BUCKET_PER_WEEK in snapshot.py).

whole_body_danger._doc: Her words (2026-06): 'Whole body > 3 min danger'. A whole-body (generalized tonic-clonic) seizure at/over the danger duration raises an URGENT safety flag (handled like a seizure emergency). PI to confirm the 3-minute line and whether unresponsiveness alone qualifies.

escalate_faster._doc: Re-cut to the 2026-06 buckets: frequent breakthrough seizures lasting 1-3 min+ -> increase faster. (<1 min while titrating is 'fine' - see continue_ok; >3 min whole-body is danger - see whole_body_danger.) PI to confirm the exact per-week cutoffs in the new buckets.

continue_ok._doc: Her words (2026-06): '< 1 min going up to goal dose fine'. Seizures under a minute are fine (especially while still titrating toward goal).

switch_when_not_helpful._doc: Her words: not helpful & unchanged >=4 weeks -> consider switch; not helpful & worse >=2 weeks -> consider switch.

lamotrigine_small_rash_workup._switch_if_on_known_sjs_risk_comed_doc: On another medication independently linked to SJS/TEN at the same time: antibiotics (esp. sulfonamides, penicillins, cephalosporins), NSAIDs (e.g. ibuprofen), or allopurinol. DRAFT default true - PI to confirm.
